Alex: Heads-up: we're running a 90-minute regional routing rehearsal tomorrow 2026-04-15 01:00-02:30 UTC. This is a controlled exercise to exercise control-plane drift detection + graceful routing fallback.
Jamie: Can you confirm impact to SLOs? We should get approval for any temporary exceptions.
sre-bot: Automated note: rehearsal_id=rr-20260415-01, runbook=/runbooks/routing-rehearsal.md, tracker=TASK-4823
Alex: Good call. We requested a scoped SLO exception for the window (prod-read p99 latency) — approved by oncall manager. Exception ticket: SLO-EXC-909. Impact is expected on p99 for ~8-12 minutes during induced announce flaps.
Maria: Which regions are in-scope? I can't join all hands if it's global.
Alex: Start with us-east-1 and eu-west-1 only. If that behaves, we'll expand next quarter.
Dan: Deployment freeze? I'm rolling a small change at 00:45 UTC.
Alex: Please hold new rollouts in the frozen groups between 00:30-03:00 UTC. If you have critical hotfixes, DM me and tag @oncall.
Jamie: Smoke tests to run post-rehearsal? Any quick cmds?
Alex: Run the synthetic latency check: curl -s https://metrics.redwood/api/synth?suite=routing | jq .p99
Alex: Also verify KV-cache warm entries: kubectl -n cache get pods -l app=kvcache -o wide and then run: curl -s http://$POD:8080/kv/stats | grep warm_prefixes
Maria: I'll coordinate with the monitoring team to watch the new synthetic traces dashboard and set an ephemeral alert channel #rehearsal-watch.
Dan: I'll pause the feature branch merges for the frozen groups. Thanks.
Jamie: If anything looks off, what's our rollback plan?
Alex: Rollback path: revert synthetic announcements in the routing controller (link to PR: https://git.internal/routing/PR-4321). Fallback policy auto-routes to regional-secondary and then to hosted fallback model. Runbook section 3 has step-by-step.
Alex: TL;DR: expect brief p99 blips, no customer-facing errors expected, but please avoid pushes to the frozen cohorts. We'll post a short postmortem + metrics in this thread within 24 hours. :white_check_mark:
